paite: Upa deuhte tai ke'nla, pa bang in thuhilh in; tangval deuhte unaupa bang in;
heading: Gingtute Lam A Timothi Mohpuakna
english: Don’t rebuke an older man, but exhort him as a father; the younger men as brothers;

paite: numei upa deuhte nu bang in; nungak deuhte siangthoutak in sanggamnu bang in thuhilh in.
english: the elder women as mothers; the younger as sisters, in all purity.

paite: Meithai, meithai taktakte zahtak in.
heading: Meithaite Saidan Ding
english: Honor widows who are widows indeed.

paite: Himahleh meithai kuapeuh in tate leh tute aneih uleh huaite'n amau insung ah Pathian limsakna mohpuakna thei masa uhenla, amau nu leh pate uh kem uhen; hiai lah Pathian mitmuh in ahoih in apom tak ngal a.
english: But if any widow has children or grandchildren, let them learn first to show piety toward their own family and to repay their parents, for this is acceptable in the sight of God.

paite: Meithai taktak amah kia nutsiat a om in Pathian tung ah lametna anei a, sun leh zan a ngen in athum gige hi.
english: Now she who is a widow indeed and desolate, has her hope set on God and continues in petitions and prayers night and day.

paite: Himahleh meithai ama nopsakna sung a kipia zaw, adam lai nangawn in asi ahi.
english: But she who gives herself to pleasure is dead while she lives.

paite: Gensiatbei a a-omtheihna ding un huaite thupiak in pia in.
english: Also command these things, that they may be without reproach.

paite: Himahleh kuapeuh in ama mite a ding angaihtuahsak louh a, ama inkuante khol houh angaihtuahsak keileh ginna azuausan a, gingloumi sang in agilouzaw hi.
english: But if anyone doesn’t provide for his own, and especially his own household, he has denied the faith and is worse than an unbeliever.

paite: Meithai kum sawmguk chiang nuailam hilou, mi khat zi hisa,
english: Let no one be enrolled as a widow under sixty years old, having been the wife of one man,

paite: thil hoih hih lam a mi phatlohta, atate vaktei khin a, mikhualte na zintun khin a, misiangthoute khe na silta a, mangbangte na dawnzang khin a, thil hoih peuhmah thanuamtak a na hih khin ahihleh meithai a gelh theih ahi.
english: being approved by good works, if she has brought up children, if she has been hospitable to strangers, if she has washed the saints’ feet, if she has relieved the afflicted, and if she has diligently followed every good work.

paite: Himahleh meithai naupang simte zaw gelh ke'n; ataksa lunggulhna un Khrist lam a akipiakna uh athuzoh chiang in pasal neih a-ut nak ua,
english: But refuse younger widows, for when they have grown wanton against Christ, they desire to marry,

paite: aginna masa uh atawpsan ziak un siam louh tang in a-om nak uhi.
english: having condemnation, because they have rejected their first pledge.

paite: Huai lou leng thadah in inn teng ah aban pawt nak ua, thadah kia leng hilou in, thu gen louh ding gen in, kamtam leh mite thilhih lai avai hawmsak nak uhi.
english: Besides, they also learn to be idle, going about from house to house. Not only idle, but also gossips and busybodies, saying things which they ought not.

paite: Huchi in meithai naupang simte zaw pasal nei in, tate nei uhenla, insung khosak ngaihtuah le uh, melmapa gensiatna ding lemtang musak kei le uh ka deih hi.
english: I desire therefore that the younger widows marry, bear children, rule the household, and give no occasion to the adversary for insulting.

paite: Meithai khenkhat Setan lam naih in apialkheta uhi.
english: For already some have turned away after Satan.

paite: Gingtami numei hiam pasal hiam in methaite nei taleh dawnzang hen; saptuamte hihbuai in om kei hen; meithai taktakte adawnzang theihna ding un.
english: If any man or woman who believes has widows, let them relieve them, and don’t let the assembly be burdened, that it might relieve those who are widows indeed.

paite: Saptuam Upa vaihawm hoihte, abik in thugen leh sinsakna a semgimte aleh nih a hih thupi tuak a seh nawn sem hi uhen.
heading: Upate
english: Let the elders who rule well be counted worthy of double honor, especially those who labor in the word and in teaching.

paite: Laisiangthou in, "Bawngtal in buh achil lai in amuk gak ke'n," achi hi. "Nasemmi loh mu tak ahi," achi nawn hi.
english: For the Scripture says, “You shall not muzzle the ox when it treads out the grain.” And, “The laborer is worthy of his wages.”

paite: Saptuam Upa hekna zaw theihpih nih hiam thum hiam kam a lou zaw sang ke'n.
english: Don’t receive an accusation against an elder except at the word of two or three witnesses.

paite: Mikhialte mi tengteng ma ah taihilh in, midangte'n leng alautheihna ding un.
english: Those who sin, reprove in the sight of all, that the rest also may be in fear.

paite: Deihsak tuam leh khentuam nei a bangmah hih lou a hiai thute zui ding in Pathian leh Khrist Jesu leh angel teltuamte mitmuh in phatuamngaitak in ka hon theisak hi.
english: I command you in the sight of God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, and the chosen angels, that you observe these things without prejudice, doing nothing by partiality.

paite: Kuamah tung ah khut nga pah ke'nla, midang khelhna ah leng kikum pah ke'n; kihihsiangthou gige in.
english: Lay hands hastily on no one. Don’t be a participant in other people’s sins. Keep yourself pure.

paite: Tui kia dawn ke'nla, na gilpi ziak in leh na hat louh nak ziak in uain neu khakha zang zel in.
english: Be no longer a drinker of water only, but use a little wine for your stomach’s sake and your frequent infirmities.

paite: Mi khenkhatte khelhna alang gige a, vaihawmna atun nak hi; mi khenkhat khelhnate bel akhonung in ahong kilang hi.
english: Some men’s sins are evident, preceding them to judgment, and some also follow later.

paite: Huchi mah bang in mi khenkhatte thil hoih hih kilang pah a-om a, akilangloute leng sel theih ahi kei hi.
english: In the same way also there are good works that are obvious, and those that are otherwise can’t be hidden.
